run_download_s2ef_data: run the download_data script to download and preprocess S2EF training data for a specified split
run_download_is2re_data: run the download_data script to download and extract IS2RE dataset to the data directory
run_download_s2ef_test: run the download_data script to download S2EF test data and move it to the s2ef/all directory
run_download_with_cleanup: run the download_data script with automatic cleanup of intermediate files after data processing completes
run_download_keep_intermediate: run the download_data script with the keep flag to preserve intermediate directories and files
